title: End-to-End: User Views Card Details Successfully
description: Verify that a user can view their card details from selection through OTP authentication to card detail display.
testDescription: As a registered customer, I want to securely view my card details so that I can use them for online transactions. The business ensures secure and streamlined access to sensitive card details verified by OTP.
prerequisites: User is logged in, card(s) are registered to user, user's mobile number is updated, no previous session locks or max attempts reached.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to 'Card Actions' in the main menu.
2. Select 'View Card Details'.
3. If multiple cards exist, select a card to view.
4. Move through the 'Preparation to View' screen.
5. Click 'View Card Details' to trigger OTP.
6. Receive OTP on registered phone.
7. Enter the correct OTP within allowed time and attempts.
8. View card details (number, expiration date, CVV, timer).
9. Click 'Finish' or wait for timer to expire.
expectedResult: Card details are shown for 90 seconds. User sees relevant info and action buttons. After timer or finish, session ends, and user is returned to card actions/dashboard.

title: Negative Scenario: Error Handling for Incorrect OTP Entry
description: Verify system response when user enters an invalid OTP, including limits and error messaging.
testDescription: As a registered customer, I want to know immediately if my OTP entry is invalid, and the system should stop me after repeated failed attempts for fraud prevention.
prerequisites: User is logged in, card is available for viewing, OTP trigger is enabled, OTP is received via SMS.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to 'View Card Details'.
2. Proceed to OTP entry screen.
3. Enter invalid OTP code (e.g., wrong number).
4. Observe error messaging.
5. Repeat incorrect OTP entry until maximum allowed attempts are reached (edge case: 3-5 times).
6. Observe session lockout behavior and error text.
expectedResult: On incorrect OTP: clear, red error message, input field resets. After max attempts: popup indicating session locked, instructions to wait and retry, return to dashboard.

title: Alternative Flow: User Resends OTP and Views Card Details
description: Verify that a user can request a new OTP (SMS/voice) if they did not receive the original code and proceed successfully.
testDescription: As a registered customer, I want the option to resend an OTP by SMS or voice in case I don't receive it, so I can still access my card details securely.
prerequisites: User is logged in, card is eligible, phone number is correct, OTP not received or expired, resend attempts within allowed limit.
stepsToPerform:
1. Initiate 'View Card Details'.
2. On OTP entry screen, click 'Resend OTP' (SMS).
3. If SMS not received, click 'Resend OTP by Voice'.
4. Receive new code via chosen channel.
5. Enter correct OTP within allowed timeframe.
6. Proceed to card details view.
expectedResult: OTP is resent and received through the selected channel. On correct entry, card details view is shown. User has actionable feedback for each resend, with lockout on exceeding resend attempts.

title: Edge Case: Viewing Card Details When No Cards are Registered
description: Validate system behavior when a user tries to view card details but no eligible cards exist or the card has just been ordered and is not yet approved.
testDescription: As a registered customer, if I do not have any cards or my new card hasn't been approved yet, I need clear messaging and options for resolution.
prerequisites: User is logged in, no cards registered, or card just ordered and approval pending.
stepsToPerform:
1. Attempt to access 'View Card Details' from main menu or after card ordering flow.
2. Observe 'No cards found' or 'No details for newly ordered card' screen.
3. Click on 'Order New Card' or 'Try Again' as prompted.
expectedResult: User sees contextual zero-state messages and is guided to order a new card or retry after approval. No error codes/stack traces, only actionable UI.

title: Security & Accessibility: OTP Authentication and Card Detail Privacy
description: Verify compliance with WCAG 2.1 accessibility, session privacy, secure handling of PII, OTP, and encrypted card details through the end-to-end workflow.
testDescription: As a user or auditor, I want to be sure that the card details workflow is equally usable with assistive tech, protects sensitive information via OTP, encryption, and visually/informationally secures user privacy (e.g. timer, warning, no card number in alt-text).
prerequisites: Accessibility tools installed (screen reader, keyboard-only navigation), user session active, OTP enabled, encrypted backend responses.
stepsToPerform:
1. Enable screen reader and keyboard navigation.
2. Complete end-to-end card details workflow, including OTP, error handling, and zero-state.
3. Monitor for accessible labeling, focus order, message timing, and alt-text.
4. Verify all sensitive card data (card number, CVV) is encrypted in transit and masked in UI unless actively viewing.
5. Attempt multiple sessions for concurrency and privacy warnings.
expectedResult: Workflow passes all accessibility checks, OTP/auth flows are accessible, all sensitive data masked/encrypted, privacy warnings appear, and session auto-ends at expiry. No unmasked data in logs/UI.

title: Boundary Value Analysis: OTP Entry Field Validation
description: Verify OTP entry field enforces exactly 6 digits, rejecting any other length.
testDescription: As a user, I want the OTP entry field to accept only 6 digits, so that partial, too-long, or non-numeric codes are always rejected and masked for security compliance.
prerequisites: User is logged in, eligible card selected, OTP challenge screen presented.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to 'View Card Details' workflow.
2. Select eligible card for viewing.
3. On OTP entry, attempt to enter 1 digit (edge case).
4. Attempt to enter 5 digits (edge case).
5. Attempt to enter 7 digits (overflow case).
6. Attempt to enter 6 alphabetic/non-numeric characters.
7. Enter valid 6-digit OTP.
8. Press submit on each entry to observe validation.
expectedResult: Only the valid 6-digit numeric entry is accepted for submission. All other cases are rejected, input field resets, and user receives clear red error message. No non-numeric or partial codes are accepted.

title: Timer Expiry: Automatic Card Data Masking
description: Validate that card details are masked and session is terminated immediately upon timer expiry.
testDescription: As a user, I want the card information to disappear and session to end automatically after the 90-second timer expires, ensuring no sensitive information remains accessible.
prerequisites: User successfully authenticated, card detail screen opened, timer visible.
stepsToPerform:
1. Initiate 'View Card Details' workflow.
2. Complete card selection and OTP challenge successfully.
3. Enter card detail display screen; observe 90-second timer.
4. Wait without any user action until timer nears zero.
5. Verify countdown and UI responses.
6. At timer expiry, observe system modal or state change.
7. Attempt to view/copy card details after expiry.
8. Attempt back-navigation to card detail screen after expiry.
expectedResult: Card detail UI and API responses are masked/shut off at timer zero. Modal confirms expiry, session reverts to safe screen, and all sensitive data is cleared from display, clipboard and cache.

title: Error Modal: No Mobile Number on Record
description: Validate system displays appropriate modal and blocks OTP when user lacks a registered mobile number.
testDescription: As a user without a mobile number registered, I expect to be blocked from the secure card viewing workflow and shown an actionable error modal instructing me to update my contact details.
prerequisites: User is logged in, no mobile number is registered to their profile.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to 'View Card Details'.
2. Select eligible card for viewing.
3. Proceed through preparation screen.
4. Click 'View Card Details' to trigger OTP.
5. System attempts to send OTP.
6. API returns error (ID=31 or 32).
7. Observe error modal popup for missing phone number.
8. Attempt to close modal and retry.
expectedResult: Error modal appears stating 'No mobile on record'. User cannot proceed. Modal offers guidance to update contact with bank and disables further attempts until profile is updated.

title: Card Brand Logic: Amex Two-CVV Workflow
description: Verify workflow, UI, and copy button behavior for American Express cards with two CVVs.
testDescription: As a user with an Amex card, I want both CVVs displayed and copy logic enforced so I can pay online and by phone, confirming brand-specific rules and UI transitions.
prerequisites: User is logged in, has an eligible Amex card, completed OTP authentication.
stepsToPerform:
1. Access 'View Card Details' for Amex card.
2. Complete preparation and OTP screens.
3. Enter card detail view; two CVV fields are shown (front and back).
4. Observe correct Amex branding (API brandCode = 3).
5. Attempt to copy each CVV separately.
6. Switch between front/back CVV screens.
7. Use timer to observe data masking per CVV field.
8. Click finish and observe session revert.
expectedResult: Both CVVs are displayed per Amex requirements. Copy and timer logic function as expected, data is masked after expiry, UI transitions between CVV views are smooth and compliant.

title: Session Masking: Back-Navigation After Card Viewing
description: Ensure sensitive card data is not exposed on back-navigation to card detail screen after session expiry.
testDescription: As a user, if I navigate back to card detail view after timer expiry or flow end, sensitive data must remain masked and safe, confirming compliance with privacy and security standards.
prerequisites: User has completed card view flow, timer has expired, session has ended.
stepsToPerform:
1. Complete 'View Card Details' workflow and OTP.
2. Allow timer to expire in card detail screen.
3. Session ends and user is returned to next screen.
4. Attempt back-navigation to previously viewed card detail screen.
5. Check browser history and cached UI states.
6. Verify masking of card number, CVV, and expiration.
7. Attempt to copy/make screenshot of masked data.
8. Validate logs do not reveal sensitive info.
expectedResult: No sensitive data is revealed upon back-navigation. UI and logs display only masked values (e.g., ****), session cannot be reentered without full authentication, and clipboard/screenshots yield masked or blank fields.

title: Preparation Screen: Verify Security, Privacy, and Timer Messaging
description: Ensure the preparation screen before card viewing displays all security, privacy, and timer guidance, and UI gating prevents bypass.
testDescription: As a user, I must be shown clear security and privacy warnings—such as no saving the card number and avoiding viewers nearby—with timer details. No user should be able to proceed to card viewing without acknowledging this stage.
prerequisites: User logged in, card available/selected, navigated to preparation screen via main menu or post-card ordering flow.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to 'View Card Details' and select a card.
2. Reach preparation screen (Sc0004).
3. Check for 'No others should be viewing the screen' advisory.
4. Validate 'Do not save card number on device' warning.
5. Observe 'Card details will be visible for 90 seconds' notice.
6. Attempt to bypass screen without clicking 'View Card Details'.
7. Click 'View Card Details' and proceed to OTP screen.
8. Attempt to back out and re-enter without repeating security notice.
expectedResult: Security, privacy, and timer advisories are shown as described. User cannot skip without clicking 'View Card Details'. Bypass attempts revert to previous step. Security messaging is enforced. UI gating is confirmed.

title: Boundary Value Analysis: Card Number and CVV Display and Masking
description: Verify that only the correct card number length (16 digits), and CVV values (3 or 4 digits per brand) are visible and properly masked before/after viewing.
testDescription: As a customer, I want masked card number and CVV in all views except during timed card detail screen, and to see only compliant digit lengths/per brand (including Amex two-CVV logic).
prerequisites: User completed OTP, reached card detail viewing; test with Visa, Mastercard, Amex cards.
stepsToPerform:
1. View card list and choose Visa, Mastercard, Amex.
2. Complete OTP successfully.
3. On card details screen, check card number (Visa/Mastercard: 16 digits, Amex: 15 digits).
4. Check CVV display—Visa/Mastercard: 3 digits, Amex: 2 CVVs (4 digits front, 3 digits back).
5. Check masking before reveal (****) and automatic masking after timer or flow end.
6. Attempt to copy masked field before reveal.
7. Wait for timer expiry and verify re-masking.
8. Repeat for all brands to confirm digit enforcement.
expectedResult: Only compliant digit length is revealed per card brand during timed viewing. Masking is enforced before/after viewing. Amex two-CVV logic and copy behavior verified. Copy/clipboard shows masked data outside timer window.

title: State Transition: User Tries to View Card Details After Attempts Limit Exceeded
description: Validate the system blocks card detail viewing after OTP send/resend or entry attempts are exhausted, showing modal dialog and preventing retry until timeout ends.
testDescription: As a user, after too many OTP sends/resends or invalid entries, I want clear blocking and messaging, with retry disabled and proper modal dialogs.
prerequisites: User attempts to view card details, exceeds OTP send/resend and entry limits (per configuration; e.g., 5 sends, 3 entries).
stepsToPerform:
1. Start 'View Card Details' workflow.
2. Attempt OTP send/resend repeatedly until system limit is hit.
3. Observe modal dialog for attempts overrun.
4. Try entering incorrect OTP until max entry limit.
5. Observe modal dialog for entry limit reached.
6. Try to re-initiate card viewing (main menu, new session).
7. Confirm retry is disabled for configured timeout (e.g., 10 minutes).
8. After timeout, retry and check workflow reset.
expectedResult: Upon limit exceed, modal dialog blocks further action with clear instructions. OTP/copy/card viewing is disabled until timeout. Retry fails within block period, but succeeds after timeout. Regulatory error text is consistent.

title: End-to-End: Multi-Card Selection and Viewing Workflow
description: Validate workflow for users with multiple cards, including card selection, preparation, OTP, card details viewing, CVV, timer, and session conclusion.
testDescription: As a user with multiple eligible cards, I want to select the specific card, complete all security and OTP steps, and view full card details and CVV, culminating in secure session end.
prerequisites: User logged in, multiple cards (Visa, Mastercard, or Amex) registered and available.
stepsToPerform:
1. Access 'View Card Details' from main menu.
2. On card selection screen, choose from multiple cards.
3. Enter preparation screen and acknowledge security/privacy notices.
4. Click to proceed to OTP.
5. Receive OTP and enter correctly.
6. View card details screen; validate timer presence.
7. Click to view CVV screen; confirm correct CVV display.
8. Click 'Finish' to complete the process and verify session masking/safe state return.
expectedResult: Workflow proceeds through card selection, security gate, OTP, details and CVV screens, and session ends securely. Action buttons and timer function as expected. UI, error states, and masking are properly handled.

title: API Contract and Data Provenance Validation in Card Viewing Flow
description: Ensure all relevant APIs are called with required headers and parameters, encrypted card data is properly retrieved and decrypted, and cache policies are enforced.
testDescription: As a system auditor, I want to validate that API contract—headers, parameters, encryption keys—are regenerated, card data is correctly decrypted, and cache is cleared after timer expiry.
prerequisites: User completes end-to-end card viewing flow; API logs and network inspection tools enabled.
stepsToPerform:
1. Initiate card viewing from main menu.
2. Select card and reach preparation screen.
3. Proceed with OTP generation; inspect network call.
4. Validate POST request with partyAccounts.bankNumber, branchNumber, accountNumber; activityTypeCode 902.
5. Enter OTP and confirm verifyOtp API call has correct parameters and headers.
6. On successful authentication, inspect GetEncryptedCardData call (authorization, encryptionKey).
7. Confirm card details are decrypted and displayed correctly during timer.
8. After timer expiry, validate cache/clipboard cleared and no sensitive info persists.
expectedResult: All APIs are called with required contract and parameters. Card details are decrypted using encryptionKey. No sensitive details persist in cache or clipboard after timer/session end. Logs and API responses remain masked/encrypted throughout.

title: Boundary Value Analysis: Card Selection List and New Card Appearance Timing
description: Verify the card selection screen correctly displays all eligible cards, including time-delayed appearance of newly issued cards, and handles boundary conditions for list size and timing.
testDescription: As a user, I want all my available cards to be shown for selection, including a newly issued card appearing only after backend approval and time delay, with boundary list size and edge scenarios enforced.
prerequisites: User is logged in, multiple cards registered, one new card recently ordered and awaiting approval, backend test data setup for edge case: card list max size and new card delay.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to 'View Card Details' from main menu.
2. Check card selection screen for presence of all eligible cards.
3. Verify new card does NOT appear if approval is pending.
4. Wait for configured backend delay after card order approval.
5. Refresh selection screen and verify new card is now present.
6. Test scenario where card list reaches maximum allowed entries (boundary value).
7. Attempt to select newly appeared card for viewing.
8. Confirm proper error/zero-state handling if no eligible cards exist or new card not yet approved.
expectedResult: Card selection list shows only eligible, approved cards including new one after time delay. Maximum boundary is respected. If zero or not-yet-approved cards, proper UI messaging and actionable buttons are shown.
cardListBoundary: Minimum 0, Maximum N cards (as defined by system), new card delay: 1 minute post approval (ASSUMPTION).
errorStatesHandled: Zero-state for no cards, pending approval message for new card, retry/refresh logic.
UIValidationPoints: Card selection panel, correct card brand image, card suffix, cardholder name.

title: Negative Flow: OTP Resend Attempt Exceedance and Retry Disabling
description: Validate modal dialogs, retry disables, and UI gating when OTP resend attempts exceed configured limits.
testDescription: As a user, if I repeatedly click 'Resend OTP' (SMS or voice) beyond the allowed limit, I want the system to block further attempts, display consistent modals, and prevent me from retrying within the configured timeout.
prerequisites: User is logged in, eligible card selected, OTP challenge active, resend counter at threshold minus one, resend limit defined (ASSUMPTION: 5).
stepsToPerform:
1. Initiate card details viewing and proceed to OTP screen.
2. Click 'Resend OTP' repeatedly up to the allowed limit.
3. Observe modal dialog after last allowed resend.
4. Attempt further resends (SMS/voice) after modal appears.
5. Confirm resend buttons are disabled and UI prevents retry.
6. Check error modal text and branding.
7. Try to refresh or re-initiate workflow from main menu during block period.
8. Wait for timeout expiry and attempt another resend.
expectedResult: Modal dialog is shown after attempts exceeded, resend UI is disabled, no further resends allowed until timeout expires, retry from main menu is blocked, modal text and branding consistent with regulatory requirements.
attemptsLimit: Configured resend limit (e.g., 5, as per domain guidance)
modalDialogText: Block and waiting instructions per regulatory specification

title: State Transition: Automatic Session Ejection on OTP Expiry or Error
description: Verify abrupt session ejection and safe state navigation when OTP code expires or critical errors occur during authentication.
testDescription: As a user, if I allow my OTP to expire or trigger a critical error (phone missing, maximum attempts exceeded), I want to be securely ejected from the workflow with masked data and routed to the safe screen or dashboard.
prerequisites: User reaches OTP entry screen, OTP code sent but not entered within expiry duration, or triggers domain-specific error (missing phone or maximum attempts lock).
stepsToPerform:
1. Initiate card viewing workflow and reach OTP entry screen.
2. Wait without entering OTP until expiry timer lapses.
3. Observe system transition to expiry error modal.
4. Alternatively, trigger error by using missing phone or repeated invalid entries.
5. Confirm modal or error screen is shown.
6. Click modal close button or retry as allowed.
7. Confirm sensitive data remains masked throughout.
8. Verify session navigation to dashboard or safe menu with no workflow re-entry unless full authentication is repeated.
expectedResult: Session is ejected and UI routed to dashboard or card action menu. No sensitive or masked data persists, no back-navigation exposure, and proper modals are displayed as per regulatory guidance.
sessionExpiryHandling: OTP expires or error is triggered, modal shows, session masked and ejected.
safeNavigation: Dashboard, card actions menu, or zero-state screen.
errorCodesTested: OTP expiry, missing mobile, max attempts exceeded.

title: UI Gating and Button State Validation Across Flows
description: Validate enable/disable behavior of actionable buttons during modal dialogs, error screens, and timed data viewing windows.
testDescription: As a user, I expect that buttons for viewing card details, copying data, resending OTP, and proceeding are correctly enabled/disabled at each phase—especially during error modals, session expiry, and critical flow transitions.
prerequisites: User logged in, eligible card selected, progressing through each screen with planned error/modal triggers; environment allows controlled timer and modal testing.
stepsToPerform:
1. Start 'View Card Details' workflow and progress to card selection screen.
2. Select card and proceed to preparation, OTP, and card details screens.
3. Trigger a modal dialog via error or expiry (e.g., OTP fail, session timeout).
4. Observe and attempt to interact with all actionable buttons while modal or error is shown.
5. On card details screen, confirm copy and finish buttons are enabled only during timer window.
6. During modal, verify all main workflow buttons are disabled.
7. After error or timer expiry, verify buttons revert to disabled or hidden state.
8. Attempt navigation/multiple clicks during modal/error and confirm prevention.
expectedResult: Button states reflect correct enable/disable logic per flow: modals and errors fully block actionable UI, timer window gates copy/data access, and UI reverts safely after expiry or error. No unintentional actions can be performed during modal display.
buttonsCovered: View Card Details, Copy Card Info, Finish, Resend OTP, Retry
modalUIBlocking: All workflow actions are blocked during modal dialog display

title: Combinatorial User Flow: Timer Expiry with Incomplete CVV Viewing and Safe State Return
description: Test scenario where user toggles to CVV viewing midway through timer, allows timer expiry before viewing returns, and confirm session masking and safe state restoration.
testDescription: As a user, if I switch from card details to CVV viewing screen with timer still running but allow timer to expire before returning, I expect all sensitive data, including CVV, to be masked, workflow to end, and session to return to safe state or dashboard.
prerequisites: User completes OTP authentication, reaches card details screen with timer active, triggers CVV toggle during timer window.
stepsToPerform:
1. Complete card selection and OTP authentication.
2. Enter card details viewing screen and confirm timer is running.
3. Click 'View CVV' to switch to CVV screen during timer window.
4. Monitor timer countdown as CVV is shown.
5. Wait for timer to expire while still on CVV screen.
6. Observe modal or automatic session masking event.
7. Attempt back-navigation or UI clicks for card/CVV after expiry.
8. Confirm return to dashboard or card actions menu with no sensitive data visible nor accessible.
expectedResult: Upon timer expiry, both card details and CVV are masked, session ends, any back-navigation or retry displays only masked/safe fields, and session returns user to home or card list. No leakage of card or CVV data during or after expiry.
timerWindow: Combinatorial timer expiry during detail/CVV view (ASSUMPTION: 90 seconds)
safeStateRestoration: Session masks sensitive data, UI reverts to dashboard or card actions

title: UI Flow: Card List Display With Brand Images and Cardholder Name Validation
description: Validate that the card selection screen displays all eligible cards with correct brand image, cardholder name, and masked suffix for each card; verify UI compliance and business rules for card display.
testDescription: As a user accessing the 'View Card Details' flow, I want to see a card selection screen showing all cards registered to me, each with a correct brand logo, masked card number suffix, and my name, assuring me that only my cards appear and the UI respects privacy and branding requirements.
prerequisites: User is logged in, at least two eligible cards registered to profile, backend provides valid response for card list API.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to 'View Card Details' from main menu.
2. Land on card selection screen (Sc0003).
3. Observe displayed cards for variety of brands (Mastercard, Visa, Amex).
4. Verify each card has correct brand image per brandCode.
5. Check cardholder name is displayed as returned from API.
6. Validate only last 4 digits (suffix) are shown per card.
7. Confirm that only eligible, approved cards are present.
8. Attempt to select each card and confirm subsequent flow to preparation screen.
expectedResult: Card selection UI displays only eligible cards with correct brand image, masked card suffix, and cardholder name. No ineligible cards are shown. Selection proceeds to preparation screen. UI passes all privacy, branding, and selection criteria.
privacyCompliance: Masked suffix, no full card number shown
UIComponentCheck: Brand image, cardholder name, select button, zero-state handling

title: Card Detail Viewing: Copy-to-Clipboard Feature Security and Masking Verification
description: Ensure copy-to-clipboard action only works during timer window when card details are unmasked, and copied value is masked or cleared after session expiry; verify clipboard masking and UI logic.
testDescription: As a user viewing my card details, I want to copy the card number or CVV to clipboard only while the timer allows, and ensure that after expiry, clipboard or logs never contain sensitive information. All copy actions must behave securely and consistently.
prerequisites: User completes OTP authentication, accesses card detail screen with timer active, card supports copying.
stepsToPerform:
1. Complete authentication and reach card detail viewing screen (Sc0012/Sc0013).
2. Observe timer countdown (90s).
3. Click 'Copy Card Number' button.
4. Validate copied value in clipboard is unmasked card number.
5. Click 'Copy CVV' button (if available).
6. Wait for timer to expire or click 'Finish'.
7. Attempt to recopy card number or CVV after expiry.
8. Inspect clipboard and logs for any sensitive data after session expiry.
expectedResult: Copy-to-clipboard functions only during timer window, copying unmasked values. After session ends or timer expires, clipboard is masked/cleared and logs show no sensitive data. Secure copy logic for card number and CVV is confirmed.

title: Boundary Value: Cardholder Name and Card Suffix Field Length Handling
description: Verify the display and handling of cardholder name and card suffix for minimum and maximum field lengths as returned from backend APIs.
testDescription: As a system tester, I want to ensure that cardholder name (partyFirstName + partyLastName) and cardSuffix fields are displayed properly for minimum, typical, and maximum allowed lengths, preventing data overflow and UI errors.
prerequisites: Test data set up with cardholder names and suffixes at min/max length, user logged in, card selection screen accessible.
stepsToPerform:
1. Access 'View Card Details' and reach card selection screen.
2. Confirm cardholder name display for minimum length (e.g., 'Al').
3. Confirm cardholder name display for maximum length (e.g., 'Alexandria-Johnathan Maximilian Smith').
4. Test suffix display for minimum digits (edge case: only 1 or 2).
5. Test suffix display for maximum allowed (edge: 4 digits).
6. Attempt to select card with max-length name/suffix.
expectedResult: Cardholder name and suffix fields display correctly for all boundary values. No UI truncation, overflow, or masking errors. Names and suffixes are never shown unmasked outside allowed window.

title: Error Handling: Backend Service Failure or Unexpected Response
description: Validate the workflow response to backend service failure (timeout, malformed data, or HTTP error) on any API call, including user-facing error screens and failure safe-mode.
testDescription: As a user or system operator, if any backend service for card viewing fails (timeout, invalid data, HTTP error), I expect the UI to display regulatory error modal, mask all data, and prevent workflow continuation, avoiding any data exposure.
prerequisites: Backend APIs are configured for test to return HTTP error (e.g., 500, 503), timeout, or invalid payload during 'View Card Details' workflow.
stepsToPerform:
1. Start 'View Card Details' from main menu.
2. Trigger card selection and preparation screen.
3. Proceed with OTP generation or card detail retrieval.
4. Force backend API to return error (e.g., timeout, error code).
5. Observe system error modal or safe screen.
6. Attempt to retry or navigate back.
7. Verify all card data is masked.
8. Confirm workflow cannot proceed until service recovers.
expectedResult: Error modal shown with compliant text, UI masks all sensitive data, workflow locked until issue resolved. No retry allowed during backend error. User returned to dashboard or safe menu.

title: State Transition: Preparation to Card Detail Viewing Flow With Single vs Multi-User Device Checks
description: Validate UI and workflow state transitions from the preparation screen to card detail viewing, enforcing privacy guidance for single-user vs multi-user device scenarios.
testDescription: As a user, when advancing from the preparation screen, I expect explicit privacy guidance and UI gating for single-user (personal device) vs multi-user (public/shared device) cases, with workflow enforcing stricter masking or warnings for multi-user devices.
prerequisites: User logged in, eligible card selected, device context set as single-user or multi-user (ASSUMPTION: device context detectable), workflow at preparation screen.
stepsToPerform:
1. Access 'View Card Details' and reach preparation screen (Sc0004).
2. Set device context as single-user; proceed to next step and observe privacy guidance.
3. Set device context as multi-user; attempt to proceed and check for additional warning or UI gating.
4. Verify UI disables card viewing unless user acknowledges multi-user warning.
5. Click 'View Card Details' to proceed in both scenarios.
6. Confirm state transition to OTP screen respects gating logic.
7. Attempt to bypass privacy warning on multi-user device.
8. Confirm workflow does not allow bypass; returns to preparation or safe screen.
expectedResult: State transition only allowed after privacy warnings acknowledged per device context. Single-user proceeds normally. Multi-user requires explicit warning and accept before proceeding. No bypass possible. UI gating and privacy logic enforced.
privacyWarningEnforcement: Additional modal or message if device is multi-user

title: Card Selection UI and API Contract Validation
description: Verify card selection screen fetches list of eligible cards using correct API headers and parameters, displays correct UI, and handles regulatory edge cases.
testDescription: As a user, when accessing the card selection menu, I want to see only my eligible cards, with accurate brand images and masked suffixes, and verify that backend services are invoked with accurate contract per regulatory requirements.
prerequisites: User is logged in, backend returns multiple eligible cards, card-channel/web-order/card-account/cards/details implemented, HTTPStatus 200 response.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to 'View Card Details' from main menu.
2. Observe card selection screen (Sc0003).
3. Inspect network requests for API 'card-channel/web-order/card-account/cards/details'.
4. Verify headers contain partyAccounts.bankNumber, branchNumber, accountNumber and activityTypeCode = 902.
5. Check each card is rendered with correct brand image.
6. Confirm cardholder name and masked suffix for each card.
7. Validate new card does NOT appear if not yet approved by backend (time delay logic).
8. Select a card and proceed to preparation screen, ensuring card selection flows correctly.
expectedResult: Card selection screen displays only eligible cards with proper masking and branding. API request contains required headers/parameters. New cards appear only after approval and delay. UI flows to preparation screen with no error.
regulatoryCompliance: No full card number exposure, only masked suffix

title: Card Data Timer UI and Backend Sync Boundary Validation
description: Ensure card data timer is precisely synchronized between UI and backend, and boundary values for expiry are handled without drift; confirm masking logic.
testDescription: As a system tester, I want to validate that the timer for card detail viewing operates for exactly 90 seconds on both frontend and backend, and that at minimum and maximum expiry points, card info is masked and sessions are handled securely.
prerequisites: User is authenticated, reaches card detail screen with visible timer, backend configures timer expiry (ASSUMPTION: 90 seconds).
stepsToPerform:
1. Complete card selection, OTP authentication, and enter card detail screen.
2. Initiate timer countdown and monitor UI for timer start.
3. Simultaneously monitor backend logs for timer state changes.
4. Wait until timer is at minimum boundary value (e.g., 1 second).
5. Allow timer to expire to maximum boundary value (90 seconds).
6. Inspect UI response at timer expiry (modal, data masking).
7. Check backend session status immediately after expiry.
8. Attempt back-navigation and copy actions after expiry.
expectedResult: Timer expires exactly at 90 seconds with UI and backend in sync. All card details are masked, copy actions are disabled, session ends securely. No drift between UI and backend timer logic.
timerSyncCheck: UI countdown, backend logs, modal display

title: Preparation Screen Bypass Attempt and Security Messaging Enforcement
description: Validate that user cannot bypass security/privacy prompts on preparation screen and no unauthorized transition to OTP or card data occurs.
testDescription: As a user, if I attempt to bypass the warnings on the preparation screen by clicking elsewhere or manipulating navigation, I expect the system to block this and enforce all security/privacy messaging as required.
prerequisites: User has eligible card, accessing preparation screen (Sc0004) from card selection.
stepsToPerform:
1. Enter preparation screen after card selection.
2. Observe all security and privacy guidance displayed.
3. Attempt to navigate away, reload, or access OTP screen directly, skipping consent.
4. Try browser forward/back or jump to OTP via URL manipulation.
5. Attempt repeated clicks in areas outside 'View Card Details' button.
6. Check if any events allow bypass into next workflow phase.
7. Confirm error or warning modal appears if bypass attempted.
8. Finally, click 'View Card Details' and proceed to OTP screen, confirming UI gating.
expectedResult: System prevents all bypass attempts; user must acknowledge security prompts before proceeding. UI gating is properly enforced, and privacy guidance always appears. No unauthorized access to OTP or card info.
securityPromptEnforcement: No navigation or direct access without explicit acknowledgment
UIBypassPrevention: Click gating, modal warning, state transition blocking

title: Mobile/Desktop Parity: Card Detail Viewing Workflow
description: Verify card detail viewing workflow behaves consistently and securely across mobile and desktop platforms with UI parity, timer, masking, and all business rules enforced.
testDescription: As a cross-platform customer, I want the card detail workflow to operate identically on desktop and mobile, including all UI elements, timer, masking, error handling, and business logic.
prerequisites: User logged in on both mobile and desktop; eligible card registered; platform-specific assets and APIs enabled.
stepsToPerform:
1. Access 'View Card Details' workflow on desktop web interface.
2. Complete card selection, preparation, OTP, and card detail viewing (timer & masking).
3. Repeat the same workflow on mobile app/interface.
4. Compare UI elements (brand images, cardholder name/suffix masking, security prompts).
5. Verify timer countdown logic, modal dialogs, and masking behaviors across platforms.
6. Trigger error scenarios (invalid OTP, timer expiry) and observe modal handling.
7. Attempt back-navigation and session masking on both platforms after expiry.
8. Validate data does not persist or leak between sessions or platforms.
expectedResult: Workflow and UI are consistent across desktop and mobile. Timer, masking, brand images, error modals, copy actions, and session handling operate identically. No platform-specific data leakage or inconsistent behavior.
parityPoints: Brand image, masking logic, timer, modal display, buttons

title: End-of-Flow Completion and Safe Navigation Handoff
description: Validate secure session masking and safe navigation handoff on completion of card viewing, including timer expiry and user-triggered finish, conforming to regulatory requirements.
testDescription: As a user, when finishing my card detail viewing session—whether timer expires or I manually click 'Finish'—I expect all sensitive data to be masked, session closed, and navigation to home or safe-action screen, with no reentry or leakage.
prerequisites: User completes card detail viewing flow, timer at expiry or user clicks 'Finish'; session masking logic implemented.
stepsToPerform:
1. View card details with timer visible.
2. Allow timer to expire, or click 'Finish' before expiry.
3. Observe modal or end-of-session screen appears (Sc0015/Sc0016).
4. Inspect UI and API responses for masking and session closure.
5. Check for actionable buttons (e.g., 'Return to Home', 'More Card Actions').
6. Attempt to navigate back or refresh after completion.
7. Confirm card data remains masked, copy actions disabled, and no leakage from logs or cache.
8. Validate that user is routed to dashboard or home screen per business rules and regulatory compliance.
expectedResult: Sensitive card data is masked after session completion (timer or finish). End-of-flow screen shows compliant text and actionable buttons. User cannot reenter card detail view without full workflow restart. UI and logs maintain masking. Navigation is routed to home or action menu.
